name: rsvp-reader
description: Read an agent's replies at your own pace, one word at a time. RSVP Reader flashes each word at a fixed focal point, cleans the Markdown noise (tables, code, links, paths), and keeps your place, so a long answer becomes a steady stream you follow without scrolling.
author: Patryck Sans
highlights: One word at a time at a fixed focal point, with the key letter highlighted so your eyes stay still
Opens where you already are: a quick-read popover in the composer, a side-panel tab bound to the current chat, or a full page
Reads the closing reply of each turn by default, with every message one click away; a banner tells you when a new reply arrives
Markdown cleaned for reading: lists, tables, code, links, paths and IDs become short readable units, and Clean/Raw shows the original
Smart pacing: pauses on punctuation, list items, numbers and long words; a slow start and a few words of rewind when you resume; your place is remembered per message, with time left
A Context box that keeps the chat's paragraphs, lists and tables, highlights the current list item and jumps on click; full keyboard control (press ? for the list)
useCases: Get through a long report, plan or review at 400+ WPM without scrolling the chat.
Keep the reader beside the conversation: the side panel follows the chat and offers each new reply as it arrives.
Work through a list-heavy or table-heavy answer: items are numbered, titled and highlighted so you always know which one you are on.
Read any text you paste (notes, emails, documents) with the same pacing and cleanup.
configuration: Nothing to set up: enable the app, then use the ⚡ chip in the composer, the + menu of the side panel, or the RSVP Reader page in the sidebar.
It reads your sessions from ~/.kiro/crew/sessions (read-only). Speed, settings and reading positions are kept in this browser's storage; the app makes no network requests.
Tune it in ⚙ Settings: presets (Minimal, Balanced, Detailed), per-category rules and pauses, and the reading display (font, spacing, focal letter).
After an update, hard-refresh the dashboard (Ctrl+Shift+R) so the browser loads the new UI files.
